description:
Compare gene essentiality across multiple diseases.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table target_essentiality — one record = the DepMap essentiality of one gene across screened cell lines.
Key: id.
Arguments: gene_id accepts ensembl gene or hgnc symbol (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: ranked by mean_gene_effect asc (verified by the harness); `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. DepMap CRISPR essentiality of genes screened in cancer cell lines; a missing gene means not screened.

gene_id.description: Accepts ensembl_gene, hgnc_symbol; resolved to one ensembl_gene (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
